name: Nythran
notes: Once organic, now cybernetically enhanced beings; underwent controlled, gradual AI integration so organic minds and AI intelligences coexist as equal citizens. Divided into Cyber-Symbiotes (fully merged) and Traditionalists (partially organic). Primary polity: Nythran Ascendancy.

naming_exemption.reason: Species name "Nythran" preserved verbatim from the cited species/civilization codex.

distribution: The organic-descended people of the Nythran Ascendancy. Note the Ascendancy is a polity of TWO peoples — Nythran organics AND AI intelligences as equal citizens; the species is not the whole citizenry.
identity_model_note: Species = a people (biology + broad cultural origin). Membership is not bounded by any single polity/faction; see member_polities (non-exhaustive) and distribution.

promotion_to_canon.rule: owner directive: promote all staged records that do not conflict with canon
promotion_to_canon.conflict_scan: zero name/office collisions; fabric linter clean; position axis unchanged

origin_polity_id_note: origin_polity_id carries the FACTION-binding form ("nythran_ascendancy"), which is also what polity_nythran_ascendancy.faction_bindings uses — so the value is meaningful, not a typo. It is simply not an entity id. origin_polity_entity_id is added alongside rather than rewriting it, the same additive pattern used when entity_id was added beside canonical_id, so neither namespace is lost.

formative_event.account_in_prose: A cybernetic revolt against organic rule that nearly caused complete societal collapse, and ultimately produced the hybrid AI-organic civilization.
formative_event.already_recorded: The event is timeline-attested to the First Civilization Expansion era; its substance was not recorded.

tension.issue: Canon describes the transition as "controlled, gradual AI integration". The prose describes a revolt and near-collapse. Both cannot be the plain account of the same transition.
candidate_readings: Sequence — the revolt came first, and the controlled integration is the settlement that followed it.
Perspective — "controlled and gradual" is the Ascendancy's official self-account; the Uprising is what occurred.
Era drift — the two descriptions come from different prose passes and one supersedes the other.
tension.why_not_resolved: No committed record narrates the transition. Choosing a reading would invent the bridge between revolt and settlement.

formative_event.broader_effect: Named alongside the Velar-Harkon Wars as a conflict that shifted territorial control and gave rise to hybrid organic-AI societies.
formative_event.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Nythran pair + Union founding, 2026-08-27

resolved_prose_question.question: Early prose asked whether Nythran is a species defined by cybernetic/neural symbiosis, a transhumanist multi-species civilization, or both — "a species defined by augmentation".
resolved_prose_question.resolution: Settled by committed canon, and closest to the third framing. species_nythran is the organic-descended people; polity_nythran_ascendancy is a state whose citizenry is two peoples, Nythran organics and AI persons, as equal citizens. The species is not the whole citizenry.
resolved_prose_question.status: CLOSED — answered by the committed identity model.
